// Common arguments: w address, g address, x address, rows_base, rows_extra.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto w_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr auto g_args = TensorAccessorArgs<w_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr auto x_args = TensorAccessorArgs<g_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_w = 1, cb_g = 2, cb_x = 0;
    const uint32_t w_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t g_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t x_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t rows_base = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t rows_extra = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t count = rows_base + (core < rows_extra ? 1 : 0);
    const uint32_t start = (core * rows_base) + (core < rows_extra ? core : rows_extra);
    const auto w = TensorAccessor(w_args, w_addr, 2048);
    const auto g = TensorAccessor(g_args, g_addr, 2048);
    const auto x = TensorAccessor(x_args, x_addr, 2048);
    cb_reserve_back(cb_w, 4);
    const uint32_t w_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_w);
    for (uint32_t t = 0; t < 4; ++t) {
        noc_async_read_page(t, w, w_ptr + t * 2048);
    }
    noc_async_read_barrier();
    cb_push_back(cb_w, 4);
    cb_reserve_back(cb_g, 2);
    const uint32_t g_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_g);
    for (uint32_t t2 = 0; t2 < 2; ++t2) {
        noc_async_read_page(t2, g, g_ptr + t2 * 2048);
    }
    noc_async_read_barrier();
    cb_push_back(cb_g, 2);
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < count; ++m) {
        cb_reserve_back(cb_x, 2);
        const uint32_t x_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_x);
        for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
            noc_async_read_page(((start + m) * 2) + k, x, x_ptr + k * 2048);
        }
        noc_async_read_barrier();
        cb_push_back(cb_x, 2);
    }
}
